alt: Google Home Speaker in Jade green with rainbow LED touch-control lights at its base and a white USB-C power cable permanently exiting from the lower-back of the unit with no visible port to disconnect it
story: The Google Home Speaker, Google's first new smart speaker in six years, launched June 25, 2026 with a permanently attached USB-C power cable — there is no port on the device, so if the cable (the most fragile component) breaks, the $99 speaker cannot be repaired without opening the case.
why_funny: Six years of development time and not a single engineer added a cable port — every previous Google speaker had a removable cord, making this the first that turns a frayed cable into a landfill trip.
